title: MULE mission configuration package
description: Per-deployment configuration for a MULE node. DRAFT SKELETON: several fields depend on trades that have not closed and are constrained loosely on purpose rather than guessed. No real identity, location, callsign or credential ever appears in a package committed to this repository; see SECURITY.md.

^_.description: Annotation keys beginning with an underscore are permitted at the top level so that every committed example can carry the mandatory header stating that its identities are fake, plus a statement of what it demonstrates or which rule it violates. They are documentation, not configuration, and a node ignores them.

schema_version.description: Package format version. A node states which versions it accepts. A node rolled back to the known-good path may be running an older image that does not understand a newer package; see FML-ADR-041 and TBR-REC-01.

id.description: Stable identifier for this mission or deployment.

name.description: Human-readable name. Never a real deployment location.

example.description: True for every package committed to this repository. A package with example=false is a real configuration and belongs in mission/local/, which is git-ignored. See SECURITY.md.

region.description: Region profile identifier under regions/. Region is an input to configuration generation, never a constant: 902-928 MHz is not permitted in the EU or UK. See regions/README.md and REGULATORY.md.

network.description: Network identity for this deployment. Values here differ between deployments so that two independently built deployments meeting at an incident do not collide. See TBR-NET-01.

mesh_id.description: Mesh identifier for the sub-GHz bearer.

local_domain.description: Local DNS domain, authoritative on the node. A fixed domain across every deployment makes collision certain. See services/ingress/.

address_prefix.description: Per-deployment IPv4 mesh prefix in CIDR notation, for example 10.83.0.0/16. FML-ADR-063: the prefix is per-deployment, not the retired program-wide constant, and is generated rather than derived from node or deployment identity -- a derived address is itself a durable identifier visible to any observer; see THREAT_MODEL.md. A node that holds an uplink whose range overlaps this prefix shall report the overlap (FML-ADR-063).

ap_ssid.description: EUD access point SSID. The passphrase is NOT part of this schema and never appears in a committed package; see SECURITY.md.

profile.description: Mission profile in force. See mission/profiles/. EMCON restricts or ceases emission; what it can actually enforce is TBR-RF-02.

services.description: Services enabled for this deployment. Every name must have an entry in services/catalog/. The schema cannot check that; a separate validator will.

trust.description: References to mission trust material. REFERENCES ONLY. No key, certificate, credential or passphrase is ever included in a package, in any form. The supply mechanism is TBD; see TBR-SEC-01 and services/identity/.

trust_anchor_ref.description: An identifier for trust material supplied out of band. Not the material.

notes.description: Free text. Subject to the publication rule like everything else.
